text: you know how you have a boyfriend and you probably shouldn't? ask him these three questions and do not blame me for how any of it goes down but one is do you think i'm your intellectual equal? two is would you move cross-country with me for a job opportunity for me and leave your career behind? and three is when we get married can you take my last name? now i have a lot more questions but these three have been tough for my like students and clients and whatnot to ask of their boyfriends you know they're like the the lowest bar to clear so just try it and see what happens so this is what passes for relationship advice now if you have a boyfriend and you probably shouldn't here are three trap questions to blow it all up and she has clients and students damn crazy world we live in first one do you think i'm your intellectual equal? on paper fair question in reality the way she frames it already assumes he secretly looks down on her if you need to interrogate your boyfriend like a school teacher checking homework you don't want partnership you want confirmation that your insecurity is correct second question would you move cross-country with me for a job opportunity for me and leave your career behind? so equality now means throw away your path your network your future so i can feel chosen? if a man asked a woman that this same lady probably would call him controlling how about two people try to find a compromise instead of one sacrificing everything for another and a third question when we get married can you take my last name? this one is the craziest again this isn't a sincere conversation about names culture or compromise it's a power check it's not how do we want to build a family identity it is are you willing to give up yours to prove you are enlightened enough to be with me these are not honest questions there are loaded compliance exams with one correct answer fail and you're a sexist in her eyes pass and you've just agreed that your role in the relationship is to sacrifice adapt move and rename yourself on command
